scope: Two finite development acquisitions on the sealed hinge coupon, not positives. Native blade sweeps only. No artificial edge deletion, truth trajectories, injections, noisy live control, exact-10 attempt, fifth closure, terminal withdrawal or post-terminal opening.
collection: Replicate the hinge control first work exposure. Flat v7 ALIGN, v11 work, rigid FK v2, but use historical v5 sweep_room including FIXED 0.250 mm protection, plus unchanged reserve 0.150 mm and radius 0.300 mm. The tested 0.2*sigma formula never enters collection. Cap the fourth closed pre-advance only; never loosen the measured fresh open closure check. Closure 1..3 must have independent fresh full-prefix BELOW(3,5,7) AND matching incremental reviews on closed return to the recorded entrance. Stop at first missing prerequisite. If full cannot complete the common approach through BELOW(7), do not repeat short. Stop the batch on any mechanical or acquisition fault. One fresh scene per case, no retries or added views.
evidence: At the fourth closure return closed to the non-ready entrance via the recorded trail. Capture one primary narrow observation; UNKNOWN cannot authorize motion. Only on a fresh known fourth frontier and agreement with the full-prefix reader may the cutter remain fixed and closed for one original work-view exposure. No further grasp/cutter command. Keep all 70-degree node/TCP references, and same-exposure constraints for each narrow frame, time/tick/q/hash bound under scoring only. Independent optical replay precedes joining structural labels. Never condition an actuation on a target structural label.
contrast: At native depth independently require full case prefix/full/partial=9, rows 7,8 optically OPEN and 9,10 INTACT with TARGET(9). Short case must have structural prefix 8 with exactly one surviving row-8 central face, no damage beyond row end 9, fresh row 8 PARTIAL and row 9 INTACT with BELOW(8). No wrong known prefix in either run. If a different physical cut occurs, report missing class, not successful discrimination. Require identical optical frames and joint commands through the fourth pre-advance decision (before differing action).
margin: Blind unchanged v11 replay: only direct row 10 from optically established late prefixes. Use nominal goal 9 pre-terminal; goal 10 for a diagnostic closed terminal chart only. Shared full-image optical-axis Gaussian draw for tool and chart. Use both fixed seed lists from calibration_v1, SeedSequence([seed,2,tick]), no refit. Compare e=1000*((limit-tip)_world-(C10-tcp)_world) dot optical_axis to 0 mm clean and 0.1000 mm at sigma=0.5 mm. Axis error <5 degrees, FK-to-TCP <=0.010 mm, valid pairs >=95% in each split, including closed and open late working samples for each case. Early row-8-or-earlier bounds never count as row-10 validation. Require the final closed full and short charts too. Duplicated captures across branches counted once per hash/tick/prefix. A pass covers observed states only: no post-target open-jaw qualification, generalization or disturbance evidence.
success: Both independently scored contrast classes, margin checks, first-frame and common-path identity, safety, shutdown and truth provenance required. Acquisition or coverage failure produces a negative decision even if a subset of observations passed. No automatic authority for a positive trial.
